heading: Research Team & Academic Supervision
subheading: Doctoral Candidates, Master's by Research Scholars & International Scholarly Collaborators under Dr. Zaid Amin's Mentorship
statement: Our laboratory fosters high-impact inquiry across Human-Computer Interaction, AI Governance, Multimodal Foundation Models, Sociotechnical Systems, and Cognitive Attention Modeling. We guide emerging scholars to bridge rigorous computational frameworks with empirical validity and ethical deployment.
